title: Require Service Router Authorship
forbids: operation authorship outside module router leaves; a leaf whose sole runtime export is not the lower-camel operation or deliberate native group mapped from its kebab-case filename and authored from the matching module branch through effect or handler; a module router index without a directly imported and registered leaf; any extra runtime leaf export; or procedure handlers inside module and root router composition files
why: Separating procedure authorship from static module composition keeps behavior module-local while the root composition rule retains sole aggregate router implementation authority.
remediate: Author exactly one runtime export in modules/<module>/router/<operation-or-group>.ts. Map its kebab-case filename to a lower-camel operation or deliberate native group, author it through the matching module branch with effect(...) or handler(...), and register that directly imported leaf in router/index.ts. Keep helpers private, module router/index.ts a plain operation tree, and root router.ts the aggregate implementation boundary.
message: Service router leaves must author and register one filename-mapped operation or deliberate native group.
